list.title: Plugins
list.intro: Plugins add views, windows and commands to Ahab, and run on your machines as you. Install only plugins you trust.

empty.title: No plugins yet
empty.text: Add one by its folder on the server's machine or its Git URL, or with <command>ahab plugins add</command>.

list.builtIn: Sessions, Terminal, Files, Git and Search are part of Ahab, not plugins: switch them on or off in <features>Features</features>.
list.browserFailed: This browser could not load it

add.title: Add a plugin
add.intro: A folder on the server's machine (built), or a Git URL (the server clones and builds it). It starts disabled.

page.missing: There is no such plugin: it may have been removed.
page.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Its files go from the server and every machine; its settings go too.

enable.title: Enable {{name}}?
enable.intro: It runs with your access, like a package you install. It:

whatItDoes.title: What it can do
